system.description: Requires Level 10+. When you channel the flames and call down a firestorm, tell the GM what you're sacrificing. The sky opens up and fire pours like rain within an area proportionate to your sacrifice; everyone and everything in the area is severely hurt or worse (2-3 conditions). Then roll+CHA.

success.label: Success!
success.value: You can extinguish the storm with some effort when you so choose.

partial.label: Partial Success
partial.value: The fires rage out of control, spreading and growing where they are carried by wind and weather.

failure.label: Miss...
failure.value: Something cruel, intelligent, and hungry arrives with the storm.
